rows.Kwic: 城子裏達魯花赤官人每根底。往來使臣每根底。本地面官人每根底。百姓每根底。眾和尚每根底。

Roles: earlier monastic-code founder named in the decree
named redactor commissioned by the decree
named reviewing editor commissioned by the decree

Override.AttributionNote: Imperially Revised Baizhang Monastic Code (勅修百丈清規), decree (法旨) issued by Imperial Preceptor Kunga Gyaltsen Pelzangpo (帝師公哥兒監藏班藏卜). The stored administrative address names local officials (本地面官人) among its recipients. Baizhang Huaihai is the earlier founder invoked by the decree; Dehui and Xiaoyin Daxin are the named redactor and reviewing editor. None is the speaker of this recipient list.
